name: deathstep
description: Deathstep monorepo root - see client/ and server/. `npm install` here installs both; `npm run dev` runs both. (Not npm workspaces - client and server keep their own independent node_modules, so this also works on filesystems that don't support symlinks, e.g. network drives.)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
